dedupe_keys.name: 국가상수도정보시스템 national water supply information system of korea tap water quality and water supply statistics

description: The National Water Supply Information System of Korea, run for the Ministry of Environment with K-water, gathers the country's scattered water supply information in one system to support policy and to serve users. The Korea Environment Institute catalogue entry read on 2026-09-28 lists its content: tap water quality test data for raw water, treated water and monitoring items across wide-area, local, village and small supply systems and sources (rivers, underflow, lakes, groundwater, seawater), the drinking water standards, and water supply statistics by region, namely service areas and population served, supply contracts by use, intake stations and treatment plants (number, capacity, output and utilisation), lengths of raw, transmission, distribution and service pipes with aged pipes, pipe materials, pipe renewal and rehabilitation, and the status of pipe GIS. Coverage is national, by local government. Access is free through the system (waternow.go.kr); the licence is not stated in the entry read. Caveats: the system itself did not load from the cloud, and statistics are annual and aggregated by utility. It supports capacity planning and ageing-pipe resilience studies of Korean water supply networks. No related Korean water supply record is catalogued yet.
licence: not stated in the entry read
